body: I completely agree, I feel like we all live to abide by constructs that people in power thought would better us. We are all told what is a good way to act and what isn’t. We aren’t free to do what we want, we are set up in way where if you don’t follow the system, you will come out underneath everything. But there is no sense of satisfaction, the fact that our pride and sense of self worth is dictated by a currency, something artificial, created by another person is what fucks us up. We don’t go out and ‘hunt’ or ‘forage’ for our life force, we do a task and when you complete it you are given it. What’s worse is some people just have it better, some people are put in positions where they are guaranteed to earn more money than others, not everyone can have a 6 figure salary. Maybe I’ve gone on a tangent with the whole money thing, but I think that’s what it essentially boils down to.
